notes.body: Adventure Zone emailed info@orofinolumberjackdays.org Aug. 17, 2026; Gmail produced delayed-delivery notices and a final failure, so there was no real contact attempt and no decline. Current event information confirms Lumberjack Days is active Sept. 17-20, 2026. Silver State Amusements currently lists Orofino Lumberjack Days on its Sept. 17-20 route, confirming an incumbent carnival. Do not guess a replacement email. Call Orofino Celebrations at 208-476-3412, verify the current decision-maker/contact path, and ask only whether there is room for a separate/supplemental family-entertainment attraction.
